operator_approval_statement: The operator explicitly grants final unpark approval for the governed v2 cutover pathway, subject to the sealed command hash and existing safety receipts. governance_note: This receipt flips approval state only. It does not execute the cutover. Any execution must occur in a separate, explicit, receipted execution lane with command hash binding and post-execution verification.
